No · S 48

CONSTITUTION OF BRUNEI DARUSSALAM

PROCLAMATION OF EMERGENCY SEAL

HIS MAJESTY THE SULTAN

AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM ln the name of ALLAH, the compassionate, the MercifuI, PRAISE be to ALLAH, the Lord of the Universe, and may the benediction and peace of ALLAH be upon Our Leader Muhammad and upon all his Relations and Friends · WHEREAS it is provided under Clause 闺 of ArticIe 83 of the Constitution of Brunei Darussalam (hereinafter referred to as "the Constitution"), that whenever it appears to His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan that an occasion of emergency or public danger is imminent, exist S or has arisen whereby the security or economic life Of Brunei Darussalam, or any part thereof, is Or m ay be threatened, whether by war or external aggression or internal disturbance, actual or threatened, he may by Proclamation (hereinafter referred to as a "Proclamation of Emergency") declare a state of emergency either in the whole of Brunei Darussalam or ln such part Of Brunei Darussalam as may be specified in the Proclamation of Emergency; AND WHEREAS on the 7th , day of Zulhijjah, the Hijrah of the Prophet (on Whom be the benediction and peace of ALLAH) one thousand four hundred and thirty corresponding to the 24th. day of November, year two thousand and nine 749

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE of the Christian Eraf we did DECLARE AND PROCLAIM a state of emergency in the whole State of Brunei Darussalam, AND WHEREAS it is provided under Clause 罔 of Article 83 of the Constitution that no Proclamation of Emergency shall be in force fo r more than two yearsr without prejudice, however, to the right of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan to issue another such Proclamation at or before the end of that period; AND WHEREAS it is provided under Clause 〔 2A 〕 of Article 83 of the Constitution that notwithstanding Clause ( 2 〕 of Article 83 of the Constitution, His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan may by another such Proclamation declare the cessation of a state of emergency in the whole of Brunei Darussalam or in such part of Brunei Darussalam as may be specified in the Proclamation · before the end of two years; AND WHEREAS it appears to US that an occasion of emergency or public danger is lmminent, exists or has arisen whereby the security or economic life Of Brunei Darussalam, or any part thereof, is or may be threatened,

NOW, THEREFORE, WE, SULTAN HAJI HASSANAL BOLKIAH MU'IZZADDIN WADDAULAH IBNI AL-MARHUM SULTAN HAJI OMAR 'ALI SAIFUDDIEN SAfADUL KHAIRI WADDIEN, SOVEREIGN AN D CHIEF OF THE FAMILY ORDER OF THE CROWN OF BRUNEI, Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan of the State and Territory of Brunei Darussalam and all its Dependencies; Do hereby DECLARE AN D PROCLAIM as of this day a state of emergency in the whole of Brunei Darussalam, AN D do hereby REVOKE our said recited Proclamation of Emergency done on the 7th. day of ZuIhijjah, the Hijrah of the Prophet ()n Whom be the benediction and peace of ALLAH) one thousand four hundred and thirty corresponding to the 24th. day of November, year two thousand and nine of the Christian Era. SO be it · Such is the Proclamation of Emergency. May ALLAH № Whom be praise and Whose name be exalted the King of Kingst vouchsafe His grace and may the Prophet Muhammad ()n Whom be the benediction and peace of ALLAH) grant His Blessings to this Proclamation , Amen! O Lord of the Universe 750 25th · AUGUST, 2011 Done at the lstana Nurul lman , Brunei Darussalamt this Sth. day the Hijrah the Pt,oph et ()n Whom be the benediction and peace of ALLAH) one thousand four hundred and thirty-two corresponding to the 9th. day of August} year tw 0 thousand and eleven of the Christian Era, being the fortyfourth year of Our Reign

BY COMMAND PENGIRAN HAJI ABD. HARIS BIN PENGIRAN HAJI SHABUDIN Permanent Secretary, Office of the Prime Minister, Brunei Darussalam. 751
